findings.finding: W5-00 through W5-07 are all unchecked and not implementation GREEN; W5-08 cannot convert partial foundations or preflight ADRs into a cumulative release gate.
the production source has zero ACTION_ADAPTERS registrations, so no real ecommerce Action journey is runnable.
there is no published exact ActionType, CapabilityBinding, Account, Adapter, risk, budget and kill matrix or allowed R2 candidate.
ActionDraft submit, policy-bound Approval, joint-binding Lease, durable Attempt/outbox, governed Receipt, Usage settlement and automatic lineage are not implemented as one chain.
manual reconcile authority, resolved provider outcome separation and policy-bound compensation remain absent, so external rollback semantics are not safe.
there is no canonical Action webhook inbox, ingress identity, replay protection or ordering reducer.
no authorized real canary, versioned kill authority, KillDrillReceipt, in-flight treatment or safe reset evidence exists.
the local browser check proves only fail-closed rendering with aos-api unavailable; no authenticated org-org full Action journey, refresh recovery, unknown reconcile or kill drill was executed.
generic TaskRun or Bundle rollback is unrelated to an already dispatched external Action; W5 has no complete reread, reconcile, compensation, reservation and incident runbook evidence.
no cumulative dashboard or exit threshold covers dispatch, provider outcome, unknown age, webhook gaps, Usage settlement, lineage, budget and kill propagation.
